//: Loops in generated maps (br-xlvx.6.4, R124), read by jj-procgen loops.rs. A loop takes a beat straight: the road steps `shiftM` to one side over `backM`, runs `runInM` straight into the loop's entry (the bots' approach and the player's run-up), and the loop (its exit `runOutRadii` radii on along the road) sets the car down back on the course's own line, the decks clearing each other, with at least `exitStraightM` of straight road after it (br-8h3u.5: the road used to ease back after the exit, and a car leaving the loop hands-off ran off its edge). `perLap` is how many a lap gets where its straights allow (not a cap on anything: a lap with more long straights could take more if this rises). `maxReliefM` is the deepest the ground may be cut to clear the deck (never below the ramp from its entry to its exit; dips are left, the loop stands over them). The deck's own sizes (`thicknessM`, `barrierHeightM`, `barrierWidthM`, `segments`) and `minSpeedMps` (carried round only above it) are the loop contract's params (jj-map looping). Nothing here caps anything.
